notes: Top-level: mid-market analytics SaaS focused on in-product insights and support automation. Primary interest: start with Hosted API for quick launch, then move to Dedicated (VPC) for predictable latency and data isolation. Key asks: SOC2 evidence (they're SOC2 certed and require peers), full SSO/SAML integration, token-level audit logs, KMS integration for key control, and retention controls (90/180/365 day options). POC summary: hosted API worked for prototype; they saw 120ms p95 for short chat workloads but want Dedicated to hit <100ms p95 consistently when toolchain integrates prefix/KV caching. Cost sensitivity: comfortable with mid-sized committed spend if unit economics improve via batching/quantization recommendations. Quotes from CTO: "We need a clean path to VPC—can't ship to customers on hosted if we can't guarantee residency and audit levels." Infra note: wants diagram of Dedicated network topology and clear peering steps (no transit gateway in their current AWS account). Legal: asks for contract language around deletion/retention and subprocessor list. Sales notes: parity with Azure OpenAI on functionality is assumed; wins are observability and canary/rollout features. Next: deliver SOC2 docs + infra diagram by 2026-03-17, schedule SAML handshake (IdP metadata exchange) and Dedicated pricing call (Ravi to lead). Jira RDW-1123 opened to track SOC2 doc delivery.
